color.$description: Raw palette. Pieces never use these directly; use the semantic roles.

white.$description: Pure white. For surface.panel (panels, sidebar) and surface.raised (controls). Not a third page surface.

neutral.$description: Cool neutral ramp. Kept deliberately small; no two steps within ~4 hex points.

50.$description: Selected row of a table (surface.selected). Holds ink-muted at 4.5:1 and ink at 16.6:1.

com.diegoeis.eis-ds.source: author's request, 2026-11-03: a lighter selected row (was neutral.100, #eaeaea), so the lighter ink-muted #6d6d6d still passes on it

100.$description: Hover of a closed disclosure summary (surface.hover). Text on it is ink (15.7:1): ink-muted fails there (4.3:1). Was the canvas until 2026-10-30.

com.diegoeis.eis-ds.source: author's choice, 2026-10-25 (was #e6e6e6, sampled from docs/visual-guidance/references/interface main-1..3)

200.$description: Data visualisation only: lowest step of the chart ramp (200 · 400 · 600 · 900). Never a surface or a text colour.

400.$description: Data visualisation only: second step of the chart ramp. Never a surface or a text colour.

com.diegoeis.eis-ds.source: was #bdbdbd; darkened 2026-10-25 so adjacent ramp steps differ by ≥1.8:1

500.$description: Mid grey. Icons, placeholders and other non-text graphics (3.5:1 on neutral.0, passes the 3:1 for UI graphics). Not for body text.

600.$description: Secondary ink. 5.2:1 on white, 4.8:1 on neutral.0, 4.5:1 on neutral.50. Never on neutral.100 (4.3:1) or neutral.200 (3.8:1): both fail.

com.diegoeis.eis-ds.source: author's request, 2026-11-03: lighter secondary text (#666666, then #696969, now #6d6d6d). Passes 4.5:1 on neutral.50, the selected row

900.$description: Primary ink and inverse surface. 15.7:1 on neutral.100.

500.$description: Accent. Marks a state or the one thing that matters; <=5% of the area. Fails as text on light surfaces (3.1:1); put neutral.900 on it (5.6:1), never white.

com.diegoeis.eis-ds.source: docs/visual-guidance/references/palette/orange-circles-grid.png, flat fill sampled exactly; chosen by the author 2026-10-25 over the TE median #f15033

700.$description: Accent when it has to BE text on light surfaces. Same hue as orange.500, darkened. 4.7:1 on neutral.100, 5.3:1 on neutral.0.

green.$description: Status colour for success. Not a second accent: it only confirms a state. green.$root is the green category colour.

$root.$description: Green category (--color-green). Not success: success is green.500. neutral.900 on it 11.5:1. Category colour: tells groups apart (tags, chips, calendar events), never a state or an accent. Text on it is neutral.900.

500.$description: Success fill: done, saved, sent. Fails as text on light surfaces (2.9:1 on neutral.100); put neutral.900 on it (5.5:1), never white (3.5:1).

700.$description: Success when it has to BE text on light surfaces. Same hue as green.500, darkened. 4.8:1 on neutral.100, 5.4:1 on neutral.0.

red.$description: Status colour for danger: an action that removes or breaks something. Only on request, never decoration.

500.$description: Danger fill (hover of a danger button). Put neutral.900 on it (4.8:1), never white (3.9:1).

700.$description: Danger when it has to BE text or a line on light surfaces. 6.6:1 on white, 6.1:1 on neutral.0.

pink.$description: Pink category. neutral.900 on it 6.9:1. Category colour: tells groups apart (tags, chips, calendar events), never a state or an accent. Text on it is neutral.900.

terracotta.$description: Light terracotta category. Softer and browner than the accent (1.4:1 apart), so it does not read as the accent. neutral.900 on it 7.8:1. Category colour: tells groups apart (tags, chips, calendar events), never a state or an accent. Text on it is neutral.900.

yellow.$description: Yellow category. Pastel almost disappears on canvas (1.1:1): the text carries the label. neutral.900 on it 13.8:1. Category colour: tells groups apart (tags, chips, calendar events), never a state or an accent. Text on it is neutral.900.

aqua.$description: Aqua category. neutral.900 on it 10.6:1. Category colour: tells groups apart (tags, chips, calendar events), never a state or an accent. Text on it is neutral.900.

blue.$description: Blue category. neutral.900 on it 9.4:1. Category colour: tells groups apart (tags, chips, calendar events), never a state or an accent. Text on it is neutral.900.

lilac.$description: Lilac category. neutral.900 on it 9.0:1. Category colour: tells groups apart (tags, chips, calendar events), never a state or an accent. Text on it is neutral.900.

pastel.$description: Share of the category hue in its pastel tone, mixed with white: color-mix(in srgb, hue calc(pastel * 100%), white). 0.5 gives the light tints of the reference (mint, cream). neutral.900 on every pastel is 11:1 or more.
